title: Ridgeline Special Order Services Tariff Note: Weekly Billing of Storage Days
content:
Longer stays at the store are billed by the week on a Ridgeline Special Order Services order in a program whose deposit at order is 50 percent: the storage days are converted into billable days by the length of the stay.

**Clause.** The storage days are the calendar days from the ready date to the completed date (to today while the item is still at the store) less the free hold, never below zero. Storage days of at least 21 are billed as 5 days for every full 7 days plus each remaining day; storage days of at least 7 but fewer than 21 are billed as 6 days for every full 7 days plus each remaining day; fewer storage days are billed one for one.

The storage charge is figured on the billable days, and the storage fee line records the billable days as its days of storage billed.

## Conversion table

| Storage days | Full weeks | Remaining days | Billable days |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5 | 0 | 5 | 5 |
| 6 | 0 | 6 | 6 |
| 7 | 1 | 0 | 6 |
| 13 | 1 | 6 | 12 |
| 14 | 2 | 0 | 12 |
| 20 | 2 | 6 | 18 |
| 21 | 3 | 0 | 15 |
| 25 | 3 | 4 | 19 |
| 30 | 4 | 2 | 22 |

## Points of reading

- The band is chosen by the storage days, and the same band's weekly figure applies to every full week of the stay.
- A stay of 20 storage days bills 18 days and a stay of 21 storage days bills 15 days.
- While the item is still at the store, today ends the count.
